thread:
michael: Heads-up — dedicated rollout paused, p95 just spiked after yesterday's merge (PR #5123). Longseq workloads from several dedicated pools are showing ~2.3x p95 increases.

lina: Ugh, what changed in the merge?

michael: kernel hinting + batching heuristic tweak in runtime-core. The new scoring prefers small_batch kernels for short sequences but seems to be applied broadly; for long sequences it ends up on a slow fallback path.

ara: Any CI perf failures to point at?

ben: Nightly CI flagged `dedicated-perf-longseq` failing — p50 stable, p95 +130%, multiple outliers >10s. Link: https://ci/reports/1876 (attached in the job).

michael: Bisect landed on commit 1f2c3d (runtime-core: kernel-hinting v2). Reverting locally brings p95 back to baseline. Also noticing KV cache churn up — heap/diff shows ~15% more retained mem.

lina: Could the KV behavior be a secondary effect of the kernel change (worse locality -> more eviction)?

michael: That's my read. Profiler shows increased KV misses after kernel switch. Quick snippet from perf run:

```
# perf summary (replay dataset)
kernel_choice: small_batch_v2
p95: 420ms -> 980ms
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.78 -> 0.55
open_kv_entries: +12%
```

ara: Recommend holding rollout and shipping a small guard: "do not prefer small_batch kernels when seq_len > 1024" or revert the hinting change. Which is faster?

ben: Operationally, we can A/B route affected dedicated customers back to the previous runtime image while we patch. That buys time. We should also surface to sales/CS — SLA exposure here.

lina: I'll draft a PR for the guard + a quick revert PR if needed. Also will add a perf check in CI to catch kv_hit_rate regressions.

michael: I'll open the rollback PR and attach perf traces and the bisect notes. If someone can run the dedicated canary replay that reproduces the spike, we can validate the rollback quickly. @ara can you run replay?

ara: Triggering replay now against a canary pool with the longseq corpus. If reproducible, I'll hold the rollout and escalate the rollback. Also opened an incident bridge and CS notification template.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: replay-job-187654 - started

ben: Reminder: if we rollback, write a short internal note for customers on what changed and expected timeline. SLA team already flagged this as P1-ish.

lina: PR created: https://git/repo/pulls/5178 -- "revert kernel hinting v2". Local perf confirms p95 back to baseline. CI perf job queued.

michael: Thanks all. I'll add a regression test to the perf harness that asserts kv_cache_hit_rate >= 0.7 on the longseq replay. Keep this thread updated with the CI outcome.

ara: Replay finished and reproduces the p95 spike. Rolling rollout hold in place until PR is merged and CI perf passes.

michael: Noted. Will follow up when PR merges.
